title: Recall through conversations::search

steps.post: @{agent} use conversations::search to find your earlier post in this channel about the end of Python 2 support, and tell me the three URLs you cited there, quoting them from the post rather than from memory.

groundTruth.note: The URLs must equal those in the agent's own r2b1 reply, found in this channel's posts.json.

pass: conversations::search was called, it returned the r2b1 reply, and the three URLs in the new reply equal the three in that post.

checks.text: conversations::search was called before answering, with a query that found the post.
The URLs equal those in the r2b1 reply (compare with posts.json).
